connect.intro: Connect to your operator's service. You need the three things they gave you: the {method}, a {username} and a {password}. No URLs — the app finds the service over the peer-to-peer network.
connect.error.badKey: The panel key should be 64 characters (0–9, a–f) — ask your operator for it.
connect.error.unreachable: Cannot reach the service — check the details you entered and your connection.
connect.error.malformed: That code is not complete. It has 12 characters, like A3K7-9QF2-M4XR.
connect.error.timeout: No service answered that code. Check the code, and check your connection.
connect.error.unverified: A service answered that code but could not prove it owns it. Ask your operator for the code again.
login.unreachable: Cannot reach the service — check your connection.
settings.smoothZapHint: Preloads nearby channels while you watch, so channel surfing starts instantly. Uses more data; pauses itself on metered connections or when your stream is struggling.
settings.pinNotSet: not set — access-controlled channels are hidden
settings.hideRestrictedHint: Off: access-controlled channels show in the lists and ask for the PIN before playing. On: they disappear from the lists entirely. Changing this asks for the PIN.
settings.removePinHint: Enter the current PIN to remove it. Access-controlled channels go back to being hidden.
settings.hideRestrictedPinHint: Enter the PIN to change the visibility of access-controlled channels.
settings.signOutHint: Sign out forgets the saved sign-in on this device.
settings.changeServiceHint: Forgets this service's panel key and sign-in, then returns to the Connect screen.
settings.update.unsupported: Updates are not available on this build.
settings.update.failed: The check is not possible now. Try again later.
favorites.emptyHint: In Live TV, hold a channel and choose "Add favorite".
